      "id": "rc:3182035442",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Update the error message so it does not state private keys are disabled when an external signer is used without private keys disabled.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author split the change into its own commit with an updated error message and test",

        "rc:3194379668"

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:3194379668",
      "status_by_quote": "Indeed. I also split this change into its own commit 996064c6db85023e0f8aa4f91277ac494821292d and added a test."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3857009395",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Toggling external_signer flag on an existing wallet leaves descriptor ScriptPubKeyMans out of sync, causing wallet operations like display address and send to fail until reloaded.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "reloading the wallet on toggle keeps SPKMs in sync; no further objection",

        "rc:3863277995",
        "rc:3863278741"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3863277995",
      "status_by_quote": "it's actually easier to just have the RPC automatically reload the whole wallet for this flag. So I went with that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3857009408",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Setting external_signer flag on a build without external signer support bricks the wallet from loading on that binary.",
      "quote": "On a build with -DENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER=OFF I set the flag on an ordinary wallet and it no longer loads on that binary, not even after a restart",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "added compile guard for ENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER; no further objection",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3863279258"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3863279258",
      "status_by_quote": "Added a guard for completeness."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3876752265",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "In an external signer wallet with private keys enabled, FillPSBT attempts to sign hot key UTXOs using the hardware signer and fails.",
      "quote": "a descriptor holding a hot key also gets an ExternalSignerScriptPubKeyMan here, and at LoadDescriptorScriptPubKeyMan. Its FillPSBT() goes straight to the device when sign=true and never falls back.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer confirmed the fix on Ledger Flex",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3878680467",
        "c:5449642921"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883522238",
      "status_by_quote": "Confirmed fixed on a Ledger Flex, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3883522238",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "What is the intended wallet layout for a multisig where one cosigner is an external signer and another is a hot key, if mixing hot and cold descriptors in one wallet is discouraged?",
      "quote": "If mixing hot and cold in one wallet isn't encouraged, what's the intended layout for a multisig where one cosigner is an external signer and another is a hot key, one wallet per key?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained the descriptor setup and key export workflow",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3893028331"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3893028331",
      "status_by_quote": "Ideally there's a single multisig descriptor for which the wallet has one key, e.g. musig2(core_xprv, ledger_xpub)."
    }

Added questions from rkrux and PraneethGunas and an interface suggestion from rkrux on error messaging. Verified existing objections were fixed and confirmed clears_with fits change for defects.",
